question: Why did the p95 latency go up on 13 March 2026?

contributing_factors.description: Deployment of a new version of the checkout service.
why_chain: Checkout v3.17 was deployed 1 minute before the change, which is right time and place.
The deployment likely introduced changes that affected the p95 latency.
The error rate and p95 latency increased shortly after the deployment, indicating the deployment was the cause.

contributing_factors.description: Configuration change to reduce the database pool size.
why_chain: The checkout db.pool_size was changed from 50 to 5 1 minute before the change, which is right time and place.
Reducing the pool size could have led to more connection pool exhaustion warnings.
The connection pool exhaustion warnings occurred shortly after the configuration change, suggesting it was the cause.

ruled_out.reason: No evidence of connection issues or failures from other services.
No evidence of bad input data or data corruption.
No evidence of network or server issues.
Deployment and configuration changes are strong candidates and are right time and place.

ruled_out.hypothesis: Increased request volume for checkout service.
ruled_out.reason: It rests on a change that is too early, or in a different service/region, to explain a sudden change here.

evidence.summary: P95 latency for service checkout rose from 222 ms to 698 ms (+215%), with a change point at 2026-03-13T11:50:00Z.
The change is concentrated in service checkout: 3 of 12 service/region segments changed; the other segments stayed flat (largest after/before ratio 1.02).
At the same time, request volume for service checkout stayed about the same (822 per 5 min before, 1008 per 5 min after, +23%).
At the same time, error rate for service checkout rose (0.45% before, 0.65% after, +45%).
Deployed checkout v3.17 to ap-south (checkout, ap-south; 1 min before the change; record R015; fit: right time and place: a strong candidate cause)
Changed checkout db.pool_size from 50 to 5 (all regions) (checkout; 1 min before the change; record R014; fit: right time and place: a strong candidate cause)
p95 latency above SLO on checkout (checkout; 15 min after the change; record R017; fit: after the change, so a symptom, not a cause)
checkout: WARN connection pool exhausted, waiting for a free connection (checkout, us-east; 8 min after the change; record R016; fit: after the change, so a symptom, not a cause)
checkout: WARN connection pool exhausted, waiting for a free connection (checkout, ap-south; 18 min after the change; record R018; fit: after the change, so a symptom, not a cause)

reasons: ✓ A change event (deploys) lines up in time (1 min before the change).
✓ 3 log/alert record(s) after the change agree with the numbers.
✓ Request volume stayed steady, ruling out a traffic spike.
✗ 1 other change event(s) fit about as well.
✓ The main factor rests on this event.
✗ Two or more changes fit equally well, so the cause cannot be confirmed.
missing_data: Details to tell the competing changes apart (e.g. a rollback test)

actions.action: Rollback the deployment of checkout v3.17
Increase the database pool size to 50
